missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Учитель' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'добрый' is the predicate adjective.

Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate masculine noun. 'Учителя' is the accusative direct object of 'любят'; for animate nouns it takes the genitive ending. 'Своего' agrees in the animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Учителя' is the genitive form showing whose desk it is. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Учителю' is the dative form required by 'верить', marking the one trusted. 'Своему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'с'. 'Учителем' is the instrumental form after 'с', expressing with whom one spoke. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об учителе' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express the topic. 'Любимом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural with irregular ending. 'Учителя' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают' with the stressed -я ending. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural of animate nouns. 'Учителей' is the accusative plural equal to the genitive plural for animate nouns. 'Всех' agrees, and 'школы' is genitive showing affiliation.
Strategic focus: Dative plural recipient. 'Учителям' is the dative plural marking those to whom flowers were given. 'Цветы' is the accusative object of 'подарили'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Учителя' is the genitive form required after the negation 'нет'. 'В классе' is the prepositional location, and 'сегодня' adds time.
